nativePageUrl.description: Exact native page entry URL; its origin must be one of the release nativePageOrigins and the deployment NATIVE_PAGE_ORIGINS.

client_id.description: This binding's own adapter IdP client id. Core's adapter PEP, read-grant and native task callbacks identify the binding only by it (unique among non-DISABLED bindings); the adapter authenticates with it and the Agent-delivered oidc_client_secret.
